title: Severe headache in pregnancy
citation: Smriti Demo Maternal Health Protocol Danger Signs 1.1
text: Severe or persistent headache during pregnancy is a danger sign. Ask about visual symptoms and blood pressure, and arrange urgent review if danger signs are present.
guidance_text: Severe or persistent headache during pregnancy is a danger sign. Ask about visual symptoms and blood pressure, and arrange urgent review if danger signs are present.
safetyNotes: Referral support only; CHW confirmation is required before saving.

title: Blurred vision in pregnancy
citation: Smriti Demo Maternal Health Protocol Danger Signs 1.2
text: Blurred vision or other visual symptoms in pregnancy can indicate a danger sign, especially with headache or high blood pressure. Escalate for same-day clinical assessment.
guidance_text: Blurred vision or other visual symptoms in pregnancy can indicate a danger sign, especially with headache or high blood pressure. Escalate for same-day clinical assessment.
safetyNotes: Keep wording non-diagnostic and support referral review.

title: High blood pressure in pregnancy
citation: Smriti Demo Maternal Health Protocol Danger Signs 1.3
text: Elevated blood pressure in pregnancy with headache, visual symptoms, swelling, or abdominal pain requires urgent referral support and supervisor notification.
guidance_text: Elevated blood pressure in pregnancy with headache, visual symptoms, swelling, or abdominal pain requires urgent referral support and supervisor notification.
safetyNotes: Do not diagnose hypertension; document and escalate.

title: Reduced fetal movement
citation: Smriti Demo Maternal Health Protocol Danger Signs 1.4
text: Reduced or absent fetal movement reported by a pregnant patient should be treated as a danger sign and referred for clinical assessment.
guidance_text: Reduced or absent fetal movement reported by a pregnant patient should be treated as a danger sign and referred for clinical assessment.
safetyNotes: Ask the CHW to confirm the report and referral plan.

title: Vaginal bleeding during pregnancy
citation: Smriti Demo Maternal Health Protocol Danger Signs 1.5
text: Any vaginal bleeding during pregnancy should be escalated for urgent clinical assessment. Do not delay referral while documenting.
guidance_text: Any vaginal bleeding during pregnancy should be escalated for urgent clinical assessment. Do not delay referral while documenting.
safetyNotes: Emergency referral support only; local clinical staff decide care.

title: Convulsions in pregnancy
citation: Smriti Demo Maternal Health Protocol Danger Signs 1.6
text: Convulsions or seizures in pregnancy require immediate emergency referral and supervisor notification.
guidance_text: Convulsions or seizures in pregnancy require immediate emergency referral and supervisor notification.
safetyNotes: Do not delay escalation for documentation.

title: Severe abdominal pain
citation: Smriti Demo Maternal Health Protocol Danger Signs 1.7
text: Severe abdominal pain during pregnancy is a danger sign. Arrange urgent assessment and document associated bleeding, fever, or fetal movement changes.
guidance_text: Severe abdominal pain during pregnancy is a danger sign. Arrange urgent assessment and document associated bleeding, fever, or fetal movement changes.
safetyNotes: Ask for CHW confirmation of symptoms and referral plan.

title: Fever in pregnancy
citation: Smriti Demo Maternal Health Protocol Danger Signs 1.8
text: Fever in pregnancy requires assessment for infection and follow-up. Urgency increases when fever is severe or combined with abdominal pain, bleeding, or weakness.
guidance_text: Fever in pregnancy requires assessment for infection and follow-up. Urgency increases when fever is severe or combined with abdominal pain, bleeding, or weakness.
safetyNotes: Use local fever and malaria guidance where relevant.

title: Swelling of face or hands
citation: Smriti Demo Maternal Health Protocol Danger Signs 1.9
text: Swelling of the face or hands during pregnancy can be a danger sign, especially with headache, visual symptoms, or high blood pressure.
guidance_text: Swelling of the face or hands during pregnancy can be a danger sign, especially with headache, visual symptoms, or high blood pressure.
safetyNotes: Do not label a condition; prompt referral review.

title: Same-day referral guidance
citation: Smriti Demo Maternal Health Protocol Referral Actions 2.1
text: When danger signs are present, support same-day referral to the nearest PHC or obstetric referral facility, notify the supervisor, and document CHW confirmation.
guidance_text: When danger signs are present, support same-day referral to the nearest PHC or obstetric referral facility, notify the supervisor, and document CHW confirmation.
safetyNotes: No record is saved until CHW confirmation.
